name: Witch's Familiar
description:
You form a magical bond with a creature of your choice with a Challenge of 0.

  • Witch’s Bond: Your familiar’s maximum Endurance is equal to either its natural maximum or your BODY, HEART, and WITS scores combined, whichever is higher.

  • Telepathic Connection: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar at any distance. As a half action, you may see and hear through your familiar’s senses for up to 1 round, sacrificing your own sight and hearing while doing so. You may end the effect early as a free action.

  • Combat & Revival: Your familiar rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn. Any time it would be reduced to 0 Endurance, you may spend 1 MP as a free action to reduce it to 1 Endurance instead. If your familiar dies, their body vanishes, and you can perform a ritual to revive them during a short or long rest. The ritual requires ingredients of Opulent Keeping (spend 4 treasure), and your familiar returns to life at maximum Endurance in a space within short range of you.

You may only have one familiar at a time. Choosing a new familiar severs the bond with the previous one.

Describe your familiar.

improvements.name: Magical Assistant
improvements.description:
Your familiar serves as a store of magical energy, increasing your maximum MP by 5.

When you cast a spell that requires touch, your familiar may deliver the spell as if it had cast it, provided it is within long range of you and uses its reaction to do so. You use your own stats for the spell.

Once per rest, if you lose concentration due to damage or unconsciousness, your familiar may assume concentration as a reaction if it is within long range of you. At the start of your next turn, you may reclaim concentration as a half action; otherwise, the spell ends.
